scenes.title: One session. One renderer.
lines: Keep Native AA and FSR installed together
Choose which renderer processes your next flight
scenes.narration: Keep Native A A and F S R installed together. This update adds one shared renderer choice, so a session uses the selected renderer while the other stays inactive.

scenes.title: Choose inside the simulator.
lines: Native AA, FSR, original simulator, or Automatic
scenes.narration: In the F S R panel, open Rendering and choose Renderer. In Native A A, open the Renderer tab. Select independent anti aliasing, F S R with neural rendering and frame generation, or the original simulator. Automatic prefers installed Native A A.

scenes.title: Keep the settings you like.
lines: Your AA, FSR, NR and FG choices are retained
The saved renderer applies after a normal restart
Your current flight continues while you choose
scenes.narration: The renderer choice saves without resetting either mod's quality settings. Your current flight continues with its existing renderer. Close X Plane normally, then reopen with your usual shortcut or third party launcher to make the switch.

scenes.title: See what is running.
lines: Current-session status stays separate from your next choice
The inactive panel explains which renderer owns the session
Fresh logs describe intentional bypass clearly
scenes.narration: Current session status stays separate from the selection for your next launch. The inactive panel explains which renderer owns the session, and fresh logs describe intentional bypass clearly. Update both mods to use the coordinated startup selection.

scenes.title: Set up, restart, then fly.
lines: FSR: match input scale and the chosen provider
Skip anytime; replay from What’s new
scenes.narration: For Native A A, use Full input scale. For F S R, match the input scale to your chosen profile. A launch from the optional F S R desktop app overrides the saved renderer for that launch only. Skip this guide anytime, or replay it from Whats New.
